items.title: What we know so far about alleged stabbing of pilot by co-pilot on flight to Israel
items.summary: Plane made emergency landing after pilot tried to crash aircraft, Israeli PM says, as officials investigate whether it was an attempted terror attackOne of the pilots of a plane flying from the UAE to Israel stabbed his co-pilot and appeared to try to crash the plane, the Israeli prime minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, said, as Israeli officials said they were investigating whether the incident was an attempted terror attack on Israelis. Here is what we know so far:A commercial plane travelling from Dubai in the United Arab Emirates to Israel was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, after an apparent brawl between its pilots prompted distress signals that briefly raised fears of an attempted hijacking. The flydubai flight was over Jordan when it diverted to Saudi Arabia, transmitting three emergency signals, one of which indicated a possible unlawful interference.The plane dipped dramatically during the reported fight, descending about 16,000ft in just two minutes. Israeli officials scrambled fighter jets, fearful of a possible hijacking attempt on a plane containing dozens of Israelis, and the plane landed at Tabuk airport in north-western Saudi Arabia.Netanyahu said one of the flydubai pilots stabbed his co-pilot and appeared to be intending to crash the plane. He added that a passenger managed to break into the cockpit with one of the crew members, and together they “neutralised” the attacking pilot.Netanyahu described it as “an extremely severe security incident”. Other officials, including the defence minister, Israel Katz, have called it an attempted terrorist attack. Netanyahu thanked the passengers and crew who helped to stop the attack, saying they “showed exceptional resourcefulness and courage”.An Israeli official has identified the attacker as an Omani national, Reuters reported. The Boeing 737 plane, which Israeli officials said had between 160 and 180 passengers onboard, transmitted a general emergency signal about two and a half hours after leaving Dubai, according to the flight-tracking website Flightradar24. items.title: 八大山人诞辰400周年 作品《个山杂画册》领衔香港苏富比秋拍
items.summary: 图为一名女士拍摄八大山人作品《个山杂画册》（局部）。八大山人，名朱耷，是明太祖朱元璋第十六子朱权后裔，今年是八大山人诞辰400周年。据学者考证，《个山杂画册》中首次使用了“八大山人”白文方形印。中新网记者 李志华 摄 图为张大千作品《黄海松云》，估价高达2000万港元。该画作于20世纪30年代后期，是张大千没骨山水技法日臻成熟之作。画中云海叠嶂，通过山峦和松树的形态，塑造了黄山独特风貌。中新网记者 李志华 摄 图为张大千作品《黄海松云》（局部）。中新网记者 李志华 摄 图为傅抱石作品《平沙落雁》，估价高达1000万港元。“平沙落雁”是古琴曲名，乐曲描写沙滩上群雁起落飞鸣、回翔呼应的情景。该画作于1955年，画面中高士抚琴于平沙远水之间，雁阵掠空、淡墨氤氲，实现了诗、画、乐三种艺术形态的浑然交融。中新网记者 李志华 摄 图为傅抱石作品《平沙落雁》（局部）。中新网记者 李志华 摄
